FBI Client File Studio

Cloud delivery system for client files

Same setup pattern as FBI Invoice Studio: use your Supabase project URL and publishable key. The client files use a private storage bucket, large uploads use resumable TUS uploads, and shared client links are handled by the public delivery function.

Setup Checklist

One-time Supabase setup.

  1. Create/use your Supabase project.
  2. Run file-studio-supabase-setup.sql.
  3. Deploy the included client-delivery Edge Function.
  4. Use the same cloud account on your devices.
  5. Upload a project and create a client share link.

Studio Defaults

Client-facing defaults.

Storage & Delivery

Operational notes.

Private storage: client files live in a private bucket. The public client page receives temporary signed download URLs through the delivery function. This keeps the raw storage objects out of the public page.
Large media: the next upgrade can add resumable/chunked uploads and background upload queues for large event videos.
